Main Stage.title: Taylor Swift Medley
Main Stage.abstract:
## **Taylor Swift Medley**

A medley of Taylor Swift (+ surprise guest artists) songs from various eras sung and performed on acoustic guitar and piano by longtime Swifties Tyler S (initials also TS) and Vash Ravi!
Main Stage.description:
Songs will encompass a variety of eras, likely to range from albums like _folklore_ to _The Tortured Poets Department_ — so there’s something for everyone, from casual listeners to diehard Swifties. <3

**Schedule:**
- Tyler: solo set (guitar)
- Vash: solo set (piano)
- Dual set (Tyler + Vash)

answers.answer:
My name is Tyler, and I was born in 2005! I’ve been a Swiftie for over a decade, loving her music from primary school all the way to university (and beyond). The Eras Tour is one of my fondest memories, and re-sparked my dream to be a singer and performer. While I’ve been singing and playing guitar for ~10 years now, there are few artists I find more therapuetic than Taylor Swift. We may have very little in common (other than our shared initials, T.S.), but we have our love for storytelling through music. 

I’m performing with my longtime friend, Vash, who always puts on Taylor Swift in the car for us to sing along to while we drive. Whether it’s at the music centre or one of our homes, we enjoy playing music together: she plays piano, while I sing and play guitar (basically, us combined = one Taylor Swift). You can often find us at the termly Taylor Swift club nights run by SwiftSoc, the only club I ever attend! 

I hope you enjoy our renditions of her songs!
Some song lyrics reference trauma, toxic relationships and mental illness.

Ramphal Theatre 1.title: The Improv Musical
Ramphal Theatre 1.abstract: Music Theatre Warwick's "The Improv Musical" is a fully-improvised musical where the show is in your hands! Our host leads the audiences through a “cheerocracy,” where the audience suggests a setting, title and two characters for our wonderful cast and live band to bring to life onstage. All scenes and songs in our show are fully improvised, and will bring laughter, fun and sometimes a little chaos to the stage for all to enjoy!  Unlike other Improv shows, our cast works not only with the audience, but also a live band to create a show that is full of joy, funky music, and leaves the audience wanting to come back and see what else they can do!
Ramphal Theatre 1.description: The Improv Musical is a fully-improvised musical where the show is in our audience's hands! Our host leads the audiences through a “cheerocracy,” a democracy where the loudest cheers win, as the audience suggests a setting, title and two characters for our wonderful cast and live band to bring to life onstage throughout the hour of performance. All scenes and songs in our show are fully improvised, with our cast and band staying onstage for the whole show, ensuring that there is absolutely no conferring or plotting backstage! Half-way through our show, the audience regains power to cheer-off plot suggestions and song genres to see in the next scene and song. We are a show for all audiences that will bring laughter, fun and sometimes a little chaos to the stage for all to enjoy! We allow our audiences to take the show in whichever direction they choose, whether that be involving all the latest pop culture references, or a show set in Medieval England! Unlike other Improv shows, our cast works not only with the audience, but also a live band to create a show that is full of laughs, funky music, and leaving the audience wanting to come back and see what else they can do!

Ramphal Theatre 2.title: Vodka
Ramphal Theatre 2.abstract: A girl attends a university house party. The drinks are flowing and she is flirting with a stranger, under the encouragement of her friends that want her to let loose and have fun. Soon the audience learns that this man that her friends have entrusted with her safety may not have good intentions.
Ramphal Theatre 2.description:
‘Vodka’ is the story of a girl (F), who is attending a university house party. The drinks are flowing, she is flirting with a stranger (M), under the encouragement of her friends that want her to let loose and have fun. Then the audience is faced with the harsh reality of spiking and we learn that this man that her friends have entrusted with F’s safety may not have good intentions. 

The play explores how friends have a responsibility to protect each other, and what happens when this responsibility is neglected. It also explores the divide and interlinking between the masculine and feminine spheres in society. 

At its core, ‘Vodka’ serves as a chilling reminder that these are real situations that happen to real people, with F simply serving as an archetype for anyone trying to navigate the world of drinking and dating.

answers.answer: Assault (explicit mention of rape), coercive behaviour, spiking, alcohol and drug use, brief moment of transphobia, audience participation

FAB Terrace.title: ASHWIN KRD SVONO - LIVE JUNE 2026
FAB Terrace.description:
Back from Sri Lanka, Ashwin Ranasinghe-de Silva returns with guitar, synth and reverb pedal to share original instrumental music. He studied chemistry with medicinal chemistry at Warwick and works on his invention/charity projects relating to medicine/climate and more.

His music project 'ASHWIN KRD SVONO' blends ambient, post-rock, soundtrack-fusion, tribal, indie, jazz fusion, electronic-ambient and many soundtrack-style influences. His music is often described as a “soundtrack for life” and explores universal themes.  

He released his first album at age 18 and has released many pieces since. As of 2026, his music has reached approximately 1 million plays across listeners in over 110 countries, with an online following of nearly 100,000.

Some listeners describe the music as inspiring, existential and ethereal, while other pieces are more reflective, peaceful and nostalgic. 

His music explores themes of journeying, hope, nostalgia, memory, peace, dreams and more.  The set will feature a range of original instrumental music. Hopefully the music can help the world in some way. 

For a sense of what to expect, here is last year’s WSAF performance:

Ramphal Theatre 2.title: Equus
Ramphal Theatre 2.description:
this is a two hour play (including interval) which although longer than a normal submission would be a great unusual piece of theatre good for the student arts festival. We have an enthusiastic team of people prepared to put on a full length play to the high standard which is present across Warwick theatre societies. we have a director and assistant director who adore this play and will no doubt create an incredible adaptation of the play. 
we want to work in a self-sufficient way, creating our own advertising and organising the production in the way of any other show at the uni, however we are looking forward to engaging with the festival as a whole wanting to be embedded into the process and working well within the entire festival.

our artistic intention for Equus is to explore its ambiguity and layered meanings, particularly the blurring of religion and sexuality, symbolised physically through movement and choreography. I want to use abstract staging and expressive puppetry to bring the horses to life and externalise Alan’s inner world, creating a sense of ritual and intensity. The production will embrace minimalism and symbolism to keep the focus on the psychological and emotional complexity, encouraging the audience to actively question and interpret rather than settle on a single explanation.

answers.answer: we are an independent production team, made up of students of various years and courses. we mainly work across single and joint honours theatre however also have some members from across the university.

Ramphal Theatre 2.title: Dead Prepared
Ramphal Theatre 2.abstract: Dead Prepared is a comedy two-hander that explores the theatrics, rituals, and emotional contradictions surrounding funeral directing. Created and performed by myself and Charlie Muskett as our dissertation project, the show centres on our alter egos (Eulogine and Wake) who are two deeply incompetent funeral directors attempting to guide the audience through the “perfect” send-off.
Ramphal Theatre 2.description:
At its core, the piece interrogates how grief is performed, processed, and often concealed. While the show is structurally comedic, it is grounded in lived experience. Drawing on personal loss, particularly the death of Maddie’s father, we believe this work perfectly reflects the strength of vulnerability. These moments interrupt the comedy to create a dynamic tension between laughter and mourning, encouraging audiences to reflect on their own relationship with grief.

Thematically, the project explores the performative nature of funerals and the discomfort society holds around discussing loss. We’ve designed this show for two performers, alongside our pianist, with a strong emphasis on physical storytelling, direct audience address and minimal yet impactful stage design. The use of a coffin - both as a comedic device and a symbolic object - anchors the visual language of the piece.

Main Stage.title: University of Warwick Wind Orchestra - Playathon
Main Stage.abstract: Made up of students and local community members, we are an unauditioned wind orchestra that plays a wide variety of music. We are performing in an **8-hour playathon** to raise money for charity, and would love your support!
Main Stage.description: We are an unauditioned wind orchestra - _open to all_! Made up of students and local community members, we are student-conducted and meet weekly to rehearse a wide variety of music. Alongside our main band, we have four small groups catering to a range of instruments: Feeling Saxy (saxophone ensemble), Flute Choir, Liquorice Sticks (clarinet ensemble), and Duck Duck Goose (oboes, bassoons, and recorders). Today we are performing for 8 hours non-stop, to raise money for charity; we hope you enjoy!

answers.answer: We're always welcoming new members, whatever your level, so if you'd like to get involved, please come along! We rehearse every Monday at 6pm in Warwick Arts Centre and if you have any questions, don't hestitate to get in touch.

Ramphal Theatre 1.title: Miscast
Ramphal Theatre 1.abstract: A show where members of Music Theatre Warwick society perform songs/dances from roles they wouldn't usually be cast or suited to in a musical.
Ramphal Theatre 1.description: Members sign up to perform through an online form where they give us the link to the backing track required for their performance. Over the 2 hours, there are many performances (solos, duets and group performances) showcasing the talent of the members, specifically in roles they were hypothetically 'miscast' for.

Ramphal Theatre 1.title: No Dancing Today
Ramphal Theatre 1.abstract: It’s been 15 years since Simon graduated, and all he’s got to show for it is a divorce, an admin job and a crush that just won’t go away. The last thing he needs is a wedding…
Ramphal Theatre 1.description: 15 years after their graduation, a group of University friends reunite at a wedding to watch two of their own tie the knot. Among the guests is Simon; bitter, stagnant, recently divorced, and feeling that this wedding has come at the worst time. As the celebrations unfold, he is forced to navigate through the various successes of his former peers, and has to battle with the memories of old friendships and emotions. On a strange day where everything seems to be going wrong, Simon has to face his worst fears in order to confront the past he was never truly able to escape.
